campaign.title: Full-proof frontier noninvertible-inequality selection gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary-source literature may be used only to state a theorem-shaped candidate and must be audited against the literal coefficient, support, endpoint, sign, and norm. Structural analogy alone is selection evidence, not proof evidence.

frozen_target.question: Among the exact nonsquare hard-TOP actual direction, the Round-122 lower-GAR cumulative wavelet, and the graded W=Y^(7/16) determinant correlation, which one admits a genuinely new noninvertible signed inequality with a stated capacity, a valid literal interface, and the strongest proof-level payoff?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Select exactly one next analytic interface only after deriving its literal target, current capacity, proposed inequality, bypass of the last no-go, exponent or graph payoff, and finite stop rule. A selection is not a proof of the selected estimate.
quantities: Hard TOP: E_ns=||A_L^ns chi_4||_2^2 with target O_epsilon(L^2X^epsilon), after the hm-square entry sector is removed only through the norm triangle
Lower GAR: the exact medium-index low-two-adic cumulative wavelet of Round 122 with target O_epsilon(RX^epsilon) against O(R^2) absolute capacity

Graded determinant: the literal W=Y^(7/16) signed nonzero determinant correlation with target O_epsilon(Y^(1/2+epsilon)); the strongest complete bound is Y^(37/48+epsilon) and the bounded-lift top shell is Y^(35/48+epsilon)
M9-M2 is mandatory on both final bridges; complete hard TOP alone would still leave BAL and UNBAL
Complete lower GAR would close the alternative total-M1 analytic parent but would not close M9-M2
The graded target would prove the internal exponent 5/16 but not M9 or the quarter theorem; a partial saving is bankable only with exact exponent propagation

A route is ineligible if its claimed gain is an invertible transform, equivalent canonicalization, height-only parity filter, ambient spectrum, separated norm, random-sign credit, or coefficient-blind bound

completion_criteria: Reproduce all three literal targets, current capacities, exact missing powers, dependencies, and downstream payoffs from accepted graph evidence.
For each frontier, state one genuinely new theorem-shaped inequality or prove that the proposed mechanism is only an already parked self-return or stronger norm.
Audit the hard-TOP square-sector norm triangle, the lower-wavelet two-adic and full-circle seams, and the graded long-lift and moving-symbol seams.
Answer arbitrary aligned coefficients, exact resonances, endpoints, floors, stars, support births, and owner duplication wherever relevant.
Rank routes by literal theorem fit, capacity deficit, dependency payoff, and finite falsifiability; do not rank by analogy or vote.
Select exactly one frozen Round-128 analytic objective and name the mechanism and stop rule, or record that no candidate is eligible and the exact innovation still missing.
State conservatively what the selection does and does not change for M9-M1, M9-M2, M9, the global exponent, and the quarter theorem.

tasks.target: Independently derive the nonsquare hard-TOP fixed-direction target and either formulate and justify a genuinely non-height-only noninvertible inequality with a credible L-factor gain, or prove the sharpest rigorous obstruction to such a mechanism.
excluded_context: all Round-75 through Round-127 nonblind artifacts
required_output: The exact hard-TOP nonsquare target and capacity ledger.
One theorem-shaped new inequality with proof sketch and first doubtful seam, or a rigorous no-go.
A ranked feasibility recommendation without any graph edit.

tasks.target: At the exact Round-122 medium-index low-two-adic cumulative wavelet, design and test one genuinely joint noninvertible signed inequality, or prove that the candidate mechanism returns the original wavelet or keeps R^2 capacity.
required_output: The exact surviving wavelet and R^2-to-R deficit.
A proved strict subrange, inverse theorem, theorem-shaped candidate, or first fatal seam.
A precise feasibility and state recommendation.

tasks.target: At the literal W=Y^(7/16) determinant correlation, design and exponent-audit one genuinely joint long-lift or prescribed-centre product-wave inequality that improves Y^(37/48), or prove the proposed mechanism cannot bank an exponent improvement.
required_output: The exact determinant target, complete and bounded-lift envelopes, and exponent propagation.
A theorem-shaped new inequality, strict proved subrange, or exact no-go with first doubtful seam.
A precise feasibility and state recommendation.

review_seams.requirement: Each candidate is the exact accepted survivor, not a stronger norm, reduced shadow, or historical formulation.
Current capacity, target, missing power, and any claimed saving use one consistent linear or energy scale.
The proposed gain bypasses the exact last no-go and is not an invertible or representation-only restatement.
Characters, orientations, lifts, endpoints, floors, stars, supports, and owner boundaries remain attached until the claimed cancellation.
Every downstream implication and exponent propagation follows through existing graph dependencies.
The round selects one next objective but promotes no unproved selected estimate.
